overview.retentionHintPageViewsOnly: Page views are retained for {{days}} days. Older data is purged.

pages.scopeHint: Library and data-room documents (agreements are managed separately).
pages.actorHint: Page views, sessions, and visitors exclude workspace members (same as Deal Radar and heat).
pages.noRoomDocuments: No files in this data room
pages.emptyDescription: Upload a document to view page engagement analysis.
pages.noAnalyticsDescription: This document has no access records yet; data will be collected after sharing links.
pages.visitorsEmpty: No visitor sessions for this document yet.

suggestions.emptyDescription: No pending suggestions. New ones appear automatically when heat signals are detected.
suggestions.radarRedirectDescription: Follow-up todos, Formal Ask replies, and warm outreach now live on Deal Radar — the action inbox.

access.title: Access audit
access.description: Permission and gate failures — slice by type, data room, link owner, and folder.
access.scopeHint: This tab audits permission and gate holds only. Pending access requests are reviewed in Share and are not counted in Held at gate. Gray gate prompts are listed for history and are not counted.
access.bucketsEmpty: No gate holds in this window.
access.emptyDescription: Blocked emails, password failures, and invite issues appear here when visitors hit a gate. Access requests live in Documents → Share.
access.pendingRequestsBanner_one: {{count}} pending access request is waiting in Share (not counted above).
access.pendingRequestsBanner_other: {{count}} pending access requests are waiting in Share (not counted above).

reasons.delivery_email_mismatch: Entered email does not match verified email

keyPages.title: Key pages
keyPages.description: Who opened financially and commercially key pages — matched by the same keywords as heat scoring.
keyPages.kpiVisitorsHint: Visitors who opened a matching page
keyPages.bucketsEmpty: No key-page views in this window.
keyPages.emptyDescription: When visitors open pages whose titles contain the match keywords below (English or Chinese), they appear here.
keyPages.matchRulesHint: Match rules (same as heat scoring): case-insensitive substring on page title. Built-in keywords follow Settings → Language. Engaged views require ≥3s dwell. Workspace extras are additive — they never replace built-in keywords.
keyPages.settingsToggleHint: Turn on to edit the default role and per-category extras.
keyPages.settingsHint: Default role changes Deal Radar copy and key-page keywords together. Built-in keywords follow Settings → Language (English or Chinese). Workspace extras always apply and merge into the active built-ins.
keyPages.customKeywordsPlaceholder: Comma or newline separated (e.g. watermark, 股权, NDA)
keyPages.customKeywordsHint: Stored under the custom category. Max 50 extras across all categories.
keyPages.categoryExtrasHint: Built-in keywords are locked. Add workspace extras per category — they merge into heat, alerts, and Deal Radar.
keyPages.settingsReadOnly: Only owners and admins can edit workspace keywords.
keyPages.colViewsHint: A title match is not a read. Dwell under 3s is a skim — kept in the record, not scored.
keyPages.colDwellHint: Skims (<{{seconds}}s) stay in the audit and are not scored.
keyPages.eventSkimHint: Title matched, but dwell was under {{seconds}}s — counted in the audit, not scored.

sessions.title: Reading sessions
sessions.subtitle: Who read, when, and how deep — one row per idle-gap session (30m).
sessions.empty: No reading sessions yet. Sessions appear after visitors view pages.

funnel.title: Reading funnel
funnel.subtitle: Idle-gap reading sessions by deepest page reached (30m gap starts a new session).
funnel.empty: No reading sessions yet. Funnel appears after visitors view pages.
funnel.sessionsHint: Reading sessions (≥1 page view; 30m idle split)

heatBreakdown.title: Why this heat level
heatBreakdown.subtitle: {{circle}} · engagement factors
heatBreakdown.keyPagesSkim: Title matched, but dwell was under {{seconds}}s — not scored

factorHints.forwardSignals: Counts confirmed forward markers from visitor sessions (not unique-visitor estimates).
factorHints.forwardSignalsDocument: Forward markers stay on the share — they are not copied onto this file.
factorHints.bouncePenalty: Opens where the visitor left without viewing any page on that link.
factorHints.bouncePenaltyDocument: A visitor who viewed only one short page on this file.
factorHints.keyPageViewsDocument: Title-matched pages on this file with dwell of at least 3 seconds. Skims are listed below and not scored.
factorHints.keyPageViewsLink: Title-matched pages on this share with dwell of at least 3 seconds. Skims are listed below and not scored.
factorHints.readingDepth: How much of this file a visitor covered in a reading session.
factorHints.qaCitations: Visitor Ask turns that cited this file — not the whole share.
factorHints.crossDomain: Distinct visitor email domains that read this file. Company names are never inferred.
